what: A full-screen image panel moves to the next image every 3 seconds with a 1.5s (power1.inOut) transition. A circular boundary spreading from the center outward (distance×2 − progress×3 + 1.5) is mixed with very fine noise (200x), so the edge fills in sparkling like stardust (WebGL). The image breathes slowly, pulling and releasing between 13% (20% on narrow screens) on a 31-second cycle, and wheel or drag flips forward or back in 1.3 seconds. Fires fx:slide-start and fx:slide-end when a transition starts and ends

options.auto: Time from the end of a swipe to the next one (seconds), default 3 — 0 means no auto advance
options.user-ease: Wheel and drag handoff curve, default power1.inOut
options.grain: Edge noise density, default 200 — smaller means coarser blotches
options.zoom · zoom-narrow: Breathing pull strength, default .13 · .2 (834px and below)
options.wait: When an event with this name reaches document, auto-advance starts (fx:open of the opening curtain)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Images (img·canvas) — passed in order. Not shown on screen, used only as textures
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on, created if missing

note: three is loaded from _vendor/three@0.176.0/build/three.cjs on a window.exports base and placed on window.THREE. Images are fitted with cover and cropped to a 16:9 (2048×1152) ratio on wide screens and 1024×1920 on narrow ones. The shader was rewritten from scratch with the same measured values as the original (not original code)

from.where: index.html .t-view (original .l-viewmain — r3f shader uProgress 1.5s power1.inOut, holds 3s after advancing, wheel 1.3s power1.inOut, uScaleIntensity .13/.2, zoomLoop sin(uTime*.2), noise ×200)
